articles.title: Vedanta Oil & Gas Posts ₹746 Cr Q2 Profit As Higher Oil Prices Offset Fall In Output
articles.description: Vedanta Oil and Gas Ltd on Thursday reported a net profit of Rs 746 crore for the second quarter of FY27 as a spike in oil prices helped offset a fall in production. The profit compares with a loss of Rs 152 crore in the preceding three months of April-June. Comparable year-on-year numbers were not available as the company came into existence only in May after demerger from Vedanta Ltd.
